title: Reject a final '.' or '..' export-path component before task-sync directory staging
outcome: Reject a final '.' or '..' export-path component before task-sync directory staging
acceptance: A task-sync directory export whose destination path ends in '.' or '..' is refused before staging with an explicit path error, instead of reaching the native no-replace move, where EINVAL would read as task_sync_publication_unsupported; a test covers both components
